description: Schema for structured Business Flow entries in a MxMocketeer Design Contract (mocketeer-spec JSON). Business Flows are embedded in Design Contract HTML files and extracted by build_artifact_index.py for graph indexing. Flows are NOT canonical YAML artifacts — they are part of the Design Contract and have Design Contract provenance. Canonical YAML always has higher authority.
title: Business Flow Entry

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this flow. Format: FLOW-NNN or FLOW-DOMAIN-VERB. Never renamed after assignment; use status SUPERSEDED instead.

name.description: Human-readable name for this flow (e.g. 'User Registration', 'Order Submission').

description.description: Optional narrative description of the flow's business purpose.

trigger.description: What initiates this flow (e.g. user action, system event, external call).

result.description: The expected business outcome when this flow completes successfully.

status.description: DRAFT: narrative only, not yet structured. OPEN: structuring in progress (steps[] may be incomplete). STRUCTURED: all steps have step_id and transitions. SUPERSEDED: replaced by another flow — keep id for backward traceability.

role_refs.description: Role IDs from roles[] that participate in this flow.

req_refs.description: Top-level requirement IDs that this flow addresses. Step-level req_refs take precedence for graph edges.

steps.description: Ordered list of flow steps. Each step with a step_id is a structured step eligible for graph indexing. Steps without step_id are narrative placeholders.

error_paths.description: step_ids of error_node steps that represent terminal failure states for this flow.

step_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this step within the flow. Format: FLOWSTEP-NNN. Never renamed after assignment. Composite graph node ID: {FLOW-NNN}:{FLOWSTEP-NNN}.

type.description: Semantic type of the step. Drives Mermaid shape selection and downstream graph semantics.

description.description: Human-readable description of what happens at this step.

screen_ref.description: Page ID (from planning/ui-inventory) where this step is visible. Produces a STEP_SHOWN_ON graph edge.

req_refs.description: Requirement IDs that this step implements or relates to. Produces STEP_PARTICIPATES_IN graph edges.

decision_refs.description: Decision IDs that govern the behavior at this step. Produces STEP_GOVERNED_BY graph edges.

role_refs.description: Roles from roles[] that act at this step.

integration_ref.description: For integration_call steps: identifier of the external system or microflow.

effects.description: Typed effect IDs from effects[] that are triggered at this step.

to.description: step_id of the target step. Must be a step_id within the same flow's steps[].

label.description: Optional human-readable label for this transition (shown on Mermaid arrows).
